fusions.name: Flattened Gland
fusions.desc: Hammers a full musk gland flat against the target, which deals 15 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Count of Three
fusions.desc: A hammering stamp of warning that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Baited Deadfall
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to rig a musk-baited deadfall at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles drops it: it deals 20 damage in a blast around it and leaves each enemy hit [Stunned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: While They Gag
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
